sources.author: Hooman
patch_list: Disable ad-free banner
Hides the banner with the frog that prompts you to buy Tumblr Ad-Free.
Disable blog notification reminder
Stops the reminder asking you to enable notifications for blogs you visit.
Disable gift message popup
Stops the popup that suggests buying TumblrMart items for other people.
Disable in-app update
Turns off the in-app update check and the update prompt.
Disable screenshot sharing
Stops the share sheet that pops up when you take a screenshot in the app.
Disable Tumblr TV
Removes the Tumblr TV tab from the bottom navigation bar.
Enable premium UI

Turns on the cosmetic Tumblr Premium look: the premium badge and the premium settings entry. This only changes how the app looks on your device. It does not buy or unlock anything on Tumblr's side, so ad-free, the badge on your blog, and a…
Remove ads

Removes the ads in Tumblr: the dashboard ads from the ad networks and the Blaze posts (the paid-promoted posts other people pay to inject into the feed). It leaves your own following feed and reblogs untouched. Premium content like ad-free…

sources.label: HushTumblr Morphe patches for Tumblr. Takes ads and clutter out of your dashboar
sources.author: HushTumblr
patch_list: Dark background color

Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Inter…
Disable analytics

Turns off Firebase crash reports and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. The Firebase and Google part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr se…
Disable update prompts
Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Updates.
Filter activity notifications
Hides selected likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops from the activity list as pages load. Each switch starts off. Choose them in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.
Fix push notifications

Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > N…
Hide ads
Takes ad cards and paid Blaze posts out of your dashboard and other feeds, and stops Tumblr asking its ad networks for more. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide advertising ID

Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.
Hide Blaze prompts

Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, and the Blaze banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interfa…
Hide blog notification reminders
Hides the pop-up suggesting you turn on notifications for a blog. Your subscriptions and notification settings stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide filtered posts

Takes the posts Tumblr covers with "This post contains filtered content" out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds, so your filtered tags and words hide them completely. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide gift purchase popups
Hides the pop-up suggesting you buy a gift for a blog. You can still open gifting yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide hashtags
Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide note counts

Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the counts off the top of a post's notes and its tabs. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTum…
Hide photo posts

Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide posts with these words

Hides posts matching your word list. Choose whether to check current text, the reblog trail, tags or summaries. Allowed words can keep a matching post, but other enabled filters still apply. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > Hush…
Hide reblogs
Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide suggested blogs

Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide suggested communities
Takes the communities Tumblr suggests you join out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide suggested tags
Takes the tags Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide text posts

Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide the ad-free banner
Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide the comment button
Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide the Communities tab
Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide the diamond and TumblrMart
Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide the Explore tab
Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide the Follow button
Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide the like button
Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide the Notifications tab
Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide the reblog button
Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide the Save button
Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide the share button
Takes the share button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Hide Tumblr TV
Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide unread dots
Hides the unread dots and counts on the bottom bar's Dashboard, Communities and Notifications tabs, with a switch for each tab. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Hide video posts

Takes video posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with a video anywhere in it, its reblog trail included, counts as a video post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Hide Watch it rows
Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
HushTumblr settings

Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard, from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the…
Mute posts locally
Adds a local mute action to post menus. Originals and their reblogs stay hidden for this account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
Remove ad tracking permissions

Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
Reorder the bottom bar
Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Reveal allowed mature content
Removes mature-content covers only when Tumblr explicitly allows them for the signed-in adult account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Show mutual markers
Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Show post timestamps
Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
Skip review prompts
Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Spoof signature for Google sign-in

Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Tumblr's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in,…
Turn off screenshot sharing
Stops Tumblr watching for screenshots, so taking one doesn't bring up its offer to save the post as an image. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
Visible image descriptions
Shows author-provided image descriptions below each image, including galleries and reblogs. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
